title: The Small Weather
author: Hazel Halloran
blurb: August Brightwater, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, has spent three years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
